The '''''Bloodshot Rancor''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] owned by the technician [[Carl Norn]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Norn made his friend [[Andronikos Revel]] [[First Mate/Legends|first mate]] on the ship, though Norn eventually lost the ship due to [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] problems.
